extracted.intended_audience: authors and programmers using TeX/LaTeX to typeset mathematical documents
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and reference entries for producing high-quality TeX/TeXbook output, focused on mathematical typesetting, page and paragraph makeup, spacing, and typographic conventions. This is an index excerpt pointing to many practical rules and parameters TeX users must manage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid bad page breaks
rubrics_metrics.description: page break: avoiding bad; forcing good
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Control page breaks with page builder/output routine; use \eject or other mechanisms to force good breaks and avoid bad/psychologically bad breaks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prevent psychologically bad breaks
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware of breaks that harm readability; use penalties, \widowpenalties, and manual controls to avoid them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid overfull boxes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detect and fix overfull boxes (overfullrule, adjust spacing or hyphenation, reflow text) to prevent protruding text into margins.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proofreading
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Carefully proofread output (including listings and printed proofs) to catch typographic and logical errors before finalizing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Punctuation in formulas
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use correct punctuation and spacing inside mathematical formulas; be careful with spacing rules around punctuation in math mode.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adhere to math writing/style conventions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the book's recommended conventions for mathematical prose and notation (see referenced sections on math style and math writing).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use correct math spacing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose appropriate muskip parameters and spacing primitives to get readable math spacing; do not rely on ad-hoc spaces in math mode.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select appropriate math fonts and symbol forms
rubrics_metrics.description: math font / symbol / math symbol for math; roman letters in math
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use proper math families, symbols, and font selections (\mathchar, \mathcode, \mathfamily) for consistent math typography.

rubrics_metrics.name: Control hyphenation and patterns
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide suitable hyphenation patterns and adjust hyphenation parameters to avoid bad breaks and overfull lines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tune line-breaking tolerance and penalties
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adjust \tolerance, \pretolerance, and various \penalty values (including split penalties) to influence line/page breaking behavior.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid forbidden commands in arguments
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not use commands that TeX forbids in macro arguments; restructure code or use safe alternatives to keep macros robust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use verbatim for literal listings
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When showing code or exact input, use verbatim environments or \setupverbatim to preserve spacing and special characters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage paragraph layout parameters
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set paragraph glue and shape parameters appropriately for the document style to achieve consistent paragraph appearance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Control page makeup and running heads
rubrics_metrics.description: page make-up / output routine / running headline / page number
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design an output routine and page makeup strategy to produce consistent headers/footers and correct page numbering; use running headline primitives as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Spacing after sentences and punctuation
rubrics_metrics.description: space after (period) and space factor handling
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Respect conventions for inter-sentence spacing; be mindful of space factors and the effects of punctuation on spacing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Typeset displayed math properly and handle text between displays
rubrics_metrics.description: text between aligned displays / display math alignment and spacing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the recommended alignment primitives for displays and ensure spacing and inter-display text are handled per style guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prevent orphans and widows
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use controls (e.g., \clubpenalty, \widowpenalty, page insertion parameters) to avoid isolated lines at page tops or bottoms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use appropriate token/register conventions
rubrics_metrics.description: token list / registers / parameter defaults / register conventions
rubrics_metrics.guidance:
Follow recommended practices for token/register usage (
ewcount, 
ewdimen, 
ewbox, etc.) and respect default values to avoid capacity and scoping issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prefer style-independent documents where appropriate
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Structure source so that style changes (fonts, spacing) can be applied without altering content; separate style from content where feasible.
